title: ESCO Engineering City domain schema
description: Domain vocabulary and entity shapes for the ESCO Engineering City API. Generated from the backend Pydantic models; do not edit by hand.

ActionType.title: ActionType
ActionType.description: The closed set of actions a model is permitted to propose.

AgentAction.description:
One proposed action returned by an agent.

``payload`` carries the action-specific body; it is re-validated against the
matching payload model before execution, so a malformed or unexpected shape
is rejected rather than partially applied.

summary.description: One-sentence, human-readable statement of what this action does.
summary.title: Summary

target_type.description: Entity kind this action concerns (project, file, finding, task).
target_type.title: Target Type

evidence_anchor_ids.description: Anchors supporting the action. Required for technical claims.
evidence_anchor_ids.title: Evidence Anchor Ids

warnings.description: Caveats the agent wants a human to see. Never suppressed.
warnings.title: Warnings

AgentAction.title: AgentAction

AgentActionRead.description:
A model-proposed action, as recorded on the run.

``accepted`` is false for actions the backend refused; ``rejection_reason``
says why. Refusals are kept rather than discarded — they are part of the
record of what the model tried to do.
AgentActionRead.title: AgentActionRead

unavailable_reason.description: Why the agent cannot run — e.g. its plugin is not installed.
unavailable_reason.title: Unavailable Reason

AgentKind.title: AgentKind
AgentKind.description: Stable identifier for an agent definition.

AgentRunRead.description:
Everything persisted about one agent execution.

Contains no chain-of-thought by construction: ``rationale`` is a concise
human-facing justification the agent is required to produce.
AgentRunRead.title: AgentRunRead

AgentStatus.title: AgentStatus
AgentStatus.description: Presence state of an agent instance.

AnchorType.title: AnchorType
AnchorType.description: The addressing scheme used by an :class:`~app.models.evidence.EvidenceAnchor`.

ApprovalDecisionRequest.description:
A human decision.

``approved`` is required and has no default: approving must always be an
explicit act, never the result of an omitted field.
ApprovalDecisionRequest.title: ApprovalDecisionRequest

ApprovalKind.title: ApprovalKind
ApprovalKind.description: Why a human decision is required.

question.description: Plain-language statement of what the human is accepting responsibility for.
question.title: Question

context.description: Snapshot of evidence and severity at request time; not re-read later.
context.title: Context

AuditAction.title: AuditAction
AuditAction.description: Auditable operations. Every member must be written by exactly one call

CreateFindingPayload.description:
Body of a ``create_finding`` action.

``fact`` and ``inference`` are separate and both required: the product must
never present a deduction as an observation.

fact.description: Strictly what the cited evidence shows, with no interpretation.
fact.title: Fact

inference.description: What the agent concludes from the fact. Presented as a conclusion.
inference.title: Inference

limitations.description: Anything that weakens the finding: partial parse, ambiguity, missing input.
limitations.title: Limitations

CreateFindingPayload.title: CreateFindingPayload

CreateRecommendationPayload.description:
Body of a ``create_recommendation`` action.

A recommendation is a proposal for a human. The platform never applies one,
and a safety- or damage-related proposal cannot be marked as not needing
approval.
CreateRecommendationPayload.title: CreateRecommendationPayload

CreateTaskPayload.description: Body of a ``create_task`` action (Project Manager Agent only).
CreateTaskPayload.title: CreateTaskPayload

DiscrepancyMatrixRow.description:
One row of the Interlock Review Agent's structured comparison.

Published as part of the contract because the frontend renders it as a
table and the reporting plugins consume it.

comparison_result.description: matched | missing_in_logic | missing_in_documentation | contradictory | naming_mismatch | ambiguous
comparison_result.title: Comparison Result

DiscrepancyMatrixRow.title: DiscrepancyMatrixRow

DocumentRole.title: DocumentRole
DocumentRole.description: The engineering purpose a file serves, as declared by the uploader or

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description: Event types broadcast over the project WebSocket.

EvidenceAnchorRead.description: A citation the UI can render and, where possible, deep-link to.

expectation.description: On a missing_expected anchor: what was looked for and not found.
expectation.title: Expectation

EvidenceAnchorRead.title: EvidenceAnchorRead

EvidenceKind.title: EvidenceKind
EvidenceKind.description: How strongly a piece of evidence supports a claim.

EvidenceRef.description: Reference from a payload to an anchor, with the role it plays.
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

parent_file_id.description: Set when this file was extracted from an uploaded archive.
parent_file_id.title: Parent File Id

FileKind.title: FileKind
FileKind.description: Classification assigned during intake, driving parser selection.

FindingCategory.title: FindingCategory
FindingCategory.description: What kind of engineering concern a finding describes.

inference.description: What the agent concluded. Always a conclusion, not a fact.
inference.title: Inference

FindingEvidenceRead.description: One citation attached to a finding, with the role it plays.

role.description: requirement | logic | context — which side of a comparison this supports.
role.title: Role

FindingEvidenceRead.title: FindingEvidenceRead

inference.description: What the agent concluded. Always a conclusion, not a fact.
inference.title: Inference

LoginResponse.description:
Returned on success.

The token is also set as an httpOnly cookie; it is echoed in the body so a
desktop shell that cannot use cookies can send it as a bearer token.
LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse

MessageRole.title: MessageRole
MessageRole.description: Author of a persisted, human-readable agent message.

ParsedArtifactDetail.description: Includes the normalised document. Can be large; fetched on demand only.
ParsedArtifactDetail.title: ParsedArtifactDetail

PostMessagePayload.description: Body of a ``post_message`` action: a short note for the activity feed.
PostMessagePayload.title: PostMessagePayload

ProjectCounts.description: Cheap roll-ups so the city view does not have to fetch every collection.
ProjectCounts.title: ProjectCounts

ReportBlockerPayload.description: Body of a ``report_blocker`` action: work cannot proceed, and why.
ReportBlockerPayload.title: ReportBlockerPayload

ReportNoFindingsPayload.description:
Body of a ``report_no_findings`` action.

Explicit rather than implied: an agent that found nothing must say so, and
say what it looked at, so silence is never mistaken for a clean result.
ReportNoFindingsPayload.title: ReportNoFindingsPayload

RunRead.description: A workflow run: the task graph created by one ``POST /runs`` call.
RunRead.title: RunRead

StartRunRequest.description: Starts a workflow run over the project's current files.
StartRunRequest.title: StartRunRequest

TaskKind.title: TaskKind
TaskKind.description: Identifies the handler that executes a task.

UpdateFindingRequest.description:
Human disposition of a finding.

Only ``status`` and reviewer notes are editable. The agent-produced content
(fact, inference, evidence) is immutable so the record of what the platform
actually said cannot be rewritten after the fact.
UpdateFindingRequest.title: UpdateFindingRequest

UpdateFindingReviewPayload.description:
Body of an ``update_finding_review`` action (Senior Review Agent only).

The senior reviewer may lower confidence, adjust severity and reject
unsupported claims. It may not delete a finding, and it may not raise
confidence above what the originating agent claimed — review can only add
doubt, never manufacture certainty.
UpdateFindingReviewPayload.title: UpdateFindingReviewPayload

UpdateModelConfigurationRequest.description: Administrator-only. The provider must already be enabled in settings.
UpdateModelConfigurationRequest.title: UpdateModelConfigurationRequest

UpdateProjectRequest.description:
Partial update. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

``status`` is intentionally absent: project status is owned by the workflow
engine and cannot be set directly.
UpdateProjectRequest.title: UpdateProjectRequest

UploadResultItem.description:
Per-file outcome of a multi-file upload.

A rejected file is reported here with the reason rather than failing the
whole request, so uploading nine good files and one executable does not lose
the nine.
UploadResultItem.title: UploadResultItem

parent_file_id.description: Set when this file was extracted from an uploaded archive.
parent_file_id.title: Parent File Id
